title: phrase matching
system_instruction_addendum: PHRASE MATCHING ADDENDUM: A phrase is four bars. Bringing deck b in on deck a's phrase-one keeps the structure intact. Frame it as bars, not seconds.

tutor_speak.text: a phrase is four bars: sixteen beats. tracks build by stacking phrases.
bring deck b in on the beat one of deck a's next phrase: throw the crossfader on that downbeat.

hints.text: count one-two-three-four across four bars to find the next phrase one.
the kick on the one is your anchor: that is where deck b should enter.
throw the crossfader on the next downbeat of deck a's phrase.
